description: Initial AI regex missed validating negative and excessive ages (>120).
how_caught: Pytest edge-case test with age=-5 and age=150.
correction_action: Added explicit age boundary check: 18 <= age <= 120.

description: Header whitespace was not stripped, leading to keys like ' age ' instead of 'age'.
how_caught: Dictionary key assertion failed on record['age'].

description: AI initially generated an O(N^3) brute-force substring search that degraded heavily on long strings.
how_caught: Performance timing check on 1,000-character test string.
correction_action: Refactored to an O(N^2) expand-around-center algorithm.

description: Overdraft counter only counted transitions from positive to negative, missing multiple negative txs.
how_caught: Pytest multi-overdraft scenario asserted count == 3 but got 1.
correction_action: Updated logic to increment counter on every transaction resulting in negative balance.

description: Discount calculation allowed total discount to exceed the cart subtotal, resulting in negative balance exploits.
how_caught: Negative price vulnerability audit ($5 cart with $10 coupon returned -$5 total).
correction_action: Enforced bounds via min(discount, cart_total) to prevent exploit.

description: AI code omitted HTML tag stripping, allowing unescaped <script> tags to pass into backend pipelines.
how_caught: Security sanitization assertion with XSS test string payload.
correction_action: Added regex-based HTML tag stripper re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', '', raw_text).

description: AI generated positive test cases only, completely missing negative price/quantity error tests.
how_caught: Code review against test coverage checklist.
correction_action: Added pytest.raises(ValueError) test cases for negative price inputs.

description: AI suggested loop condition 'while low < high', missing the target element when located at the upper boundary.
correction_action: Corrected loop invariant to 'while low <= high'.

description: AI generated a class wrapper but retained 'tags=[]' in method signature, preserving the mutable bug.
how_caught: Pytest multiple task addition test showed tags leaking across separate instances.
correction_action: Changed default to tags=None and assigned new list inside method body.

description: Floating point temperature conversions had long floating point precision tails.
how_caught: Output string formatting assertion failed on float representation.
correction_action: Explicitly rounded temperatures to 1 decimal place.
